headline: Aksh Optifibre Limited: NCLT Order in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Aksh Optifibre Limited has received an NCLT order initiating a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The NSE intimation confirms formal entry into IBC proceedings.
detail: Aksh Optifibre Limited, a publicly listed optical fibre and cable manufacturer, has formally entered Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process following an NCLT order dated on or before 22 June 2026. The company has disclosed this material event to NSE as a statutory requirement under the Listing Regulations. The CIRP process will be managed by an appointed Insolvency Professional (IP) who will evaluate resolution plans or proceed to liquidation based on creditor voting. The 180-day moratorium freezes all legal proceedings and creditor actions against the company.
